{{Term/Store|Log|Logs|Series, FSA, SS, SSHD, TotK|plural}} are recurring [[Object]]s in {{TLoZ Series}}.{{Exp Game|FSA, SSHD, TotK}}<ref name="FSA Guide 49"/><ref name="SSHD Eagus"/><ref name="TotK Game Screen"/> Logs go unnamed in {{BotW}} and {{AoC}}.

==Overview==
==={{FSA|-}}===
{{Stub}}

==={{SS|-}}===
{{Descriptions SS}}
Eight Logs can be found in the [[Sparring Hall]] at [[Skyloft]], each marked with a different spot for [[Link]] to practice his [[Link's Sword Strike|Sword Strikes]]. If Link successfully destroys them all, [[Eagus]] will set up an additional ring of eight for Link to perform a [[Spin Attack]], then one final Log to practice the [[Fatal Blow]].

==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Stub|BotW}}

==={{TotK|-}}===
Logs are the cut-down remnants of [[Tree]]s. They can be [[Fuse]]d with [[Weapon]]s to create new Weapons, or they can be bonded together with the [[Ultrahand]] ability to form more complex [[Object]]s such as [[Raft]]s.
